errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една линия в син цвят, обозначена с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two distinct data series: a solid blue line and a series of blue circular markers (a dotted line). The description incorrectly claims there is only one line.
The description completely omits any mention of the solid blue line, which is one of the two data series presented in the chart.

errors.text_span: Линията започва в точката (2018, около 12600), след което постепенно се увеличава до точката (2022, около 23000).
errors.evidence: The description conflates the two separate data series. It uses the starting value from the dotted line (approx. 12,600 in 2018) but an ending value (approx. 23,000 in 2022) which is a significant overestimation of the solid line's end point (approx. 22,500) and even more so for the dotted line's end point (approx. 20,800).

errors.text_span: В участъка между 2019 и 2021 линията демонстрира по-стръмна тенденция на нарастване в сравнение с участъка от 2018 до 2019 и от 2021 до 2022.
errors.evidence: The description makes a subjective comparison about the steepness of the trend ("по-стръмна тенденция на нарастване"), which constitutes interpretation rather than an objective description of the visual data. The prompt explicitly instructs to avoid interpretation.

errors.text_span: Тегло на наклона на линията се променя видимо по протежение на оста X.
errors.evidence: The phrase "Тегло на наклона" (weight of the slope) is non-standard, unscientific, and ambiguous. It is unclear what is meant by the 'weight' of a slope.
